recognize_zh: 周邊血中多個中型淋巴樣細胞，具中等量深嗜鹼性、無顆粒的胞質，核圓形至不規則（有凹陷），染色質中度濃縮，部分可見單一明顯核仁，符合 T 前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small mature lymphocytes
Moderate amounts of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular or indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single visible nucleolus in some cells
Occasional cytoplasmic protrusions at the cell border; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of basophilic agranular cytoplasm and round to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei. The chromatin is moderately condensed and a single nucleolus is visible in some cells. No granules or cerebriform nuclear folding are seen. Findings are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context; flow cytometry, TCL1 staining and cytogenetics for inv(14)/t(14;14) are recommended.

ddx.vs: B-PLL cells have more prominent central nucleoli and less basophilic cytoplasm and are CD19/CD20-positive by flow cytometry.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and often lack CD7 and CD26.
ATLL cells are polylobated flower cells, CD25-positive, and associated with HTLV-1 infection.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and are CD8/CD57-positive.
